svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut UPN 100 channel 640 mm long. It lies web up: the flat

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm web on top, the two 50 mm flanges standing on the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Anchor tubes: 14 mm hole through the web 260 mm each side of the middle;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: weld a 26.9 x 3.2 mm tube, 44 mm long, under each hole, floor to web.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Studs: four 13 mm holes in the web, 25 mm each side of the centre line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (lengthwise) and 88 mm each side of the middle. Put an M12 x 40 bolt

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up through each from below and weld its head under the web.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the base beam's bottom flanges sit flat on the web; the studs go

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through them, nut and washer on top. The upright stands on the web.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: M12 anchors, 80 mm into concrete, down through the tubes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the web is flat and the four studs stand square and at
